    internal static class QuartzDeclaredJobs

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds every job this assembly declares, and every schedule those jobs declare.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="builder">The scheduler being built.</param>
        /// <returns>The same builder, so that the call chains.</returns>
        public static global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder AddDeclaredJobs(this global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder builder)
        {
            builder.AddJob<global::App.CleanupJob>(job => job
                .WithIdentity("cleanup"));

            builder.AddConfiguredTrigger<global::App.CleanupJob>("Jobs:Cleanup:Cron", Configured, (services, configured, trigger) => trigger
                .WithIdentity("cleanup")
                .ForJob("cleanup")
                .WithCronSchedule(configured ?? "0 0 3 * * ?"));

            builder.AddConfiguredTrigger<global::App.CleanupJob>("Jobs:Cleanup:Noon", Configured, (services, configured, trigger) => trigger
                .WithIdentity("noon")
                .ForJob("cleanup")
                .WithCronSchedule(configured ?? "0 0 12 ? * MON-FRI", cron => cron
                    .InTimeZone(global::Quartz.TimeZones.FindById("UTC"))));

            builder.AddTrigger<global::App.CleanupJob>(trigger => trigger
                .WithIdentity("evening")
                .ForJob("cleanup")
                .WithCronSchedule("0 0 18 * * ?"));

            return builder;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The same as <c>AddDeclaredJobs</c>, under a name no other assembly's registration shares, so
        /// that it binds wherever this assembly's is visible, however many others are visible beside it.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="builder">The scheduler being built.</param>

        public static global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder AddDeclaredJobsFromSnippet(this global::Quartz.IQuartzBuilder builder)

        /// <summary>
        /// The value configured at <paramref name="key" />, or <see langword="null" /> where the key is
        /// not set or no configuration is registered.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="services">The scheduler's view of the container.</param>
        /// <param name="key">The attribute's <c>ConfigurationKey</c>.</param>
        /// <returns>The configured schedule, which <c>-</c> switches off.</returns>
        private static string? Configured(global::System.IServiceProvider services, string key)
        {
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration? configuration =
                services.GetService(typeof(global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration)) as global::Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration;

            return configuration?[key];
